reason: The AWS Documentation MCP server (src/aws-documentation-mcp-server) runs on CPU over stdio and needs no AWS credentials, only public internet access to docs.aws.amazon.com.
demo: README -> src/aws-documentation-mcp-server (AWS Documentation MCP Server): install and start the stdio server, then call its read_documentation tool
goal: Install the awslabs.aws-documentation-mcp-server package from /work/mcp/src/aws-documentation-mcp-server (Python >=3.10, for example with uv or pip) into the environment that /work/env.sh activates. The `awslabs.aws-documentation-mcp-server` command, or `python -m awslabs.aws_documentation_mcp_server.server`, must start the stdio MCP server. Through an MCP client, the tools list must include read_documentation and search_documentation. Calling read_documentation on https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html must return the page content as markdown.
check: The hidden test starts the installed server over stdio with an MCP client, lists the tools, calls read_documentation on a Lambda docs page and verifies that substantial Lambda-related text comes back.
